name: Fixed-point line rasterizer
format: Q4: one unit is 16 register counts; R2/R7 start at 8 for rounding, add 6 per pixel, R4 masks with 240. Eight unrolled iterations. Alternating scratch registers preserve stable read operands.
sample: Actual Minecraft Java 1.21.7 state, beginning of every game tick; not within-tick block updates.
